# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.4 — Reliable updates

## 🛠️ Fixed

### 🔄 "Restart & Install" now opens the new version the first time
- After an update, the app could reopen an **old copy of itself** (left over from the portable version) instead of the version that was just installed — so it looked like nothing had changed, and you had to update again and again.
- The cause was a **Start Menu shortcut pointing to that old copy**. The installer now points the Start Menu and desktop shortcuts back to the installed app on every update, and the app also checks and repairs them when it starts.
- Shortcuts you deleted yourself are never recreated.
- *Settings → Apps* now shows the right version number.

Already on 1.2.x? The app offers this update automatically — click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**. The fix is in the installer itself, so this update already opens the new version directly.
